hypotheses.primary: Within identical input-information lane and target calibration budget, compare paired localization and actual FPR. Claim improvement only if externally held-out paired inference supports gain, without violating control budget and preservation gates.
hypotheses.secondary: Measure contribution of ON/OFF by within-method paired contrast from lane A to B; do not attribute extra evidence to intrinsic detector superiority.

A.name: single_view
A.information: Same one ON scan, native time/frequency units, mask, tile/coverage, no OFF, repeated scan, truth, weights derived from repeat, or reference registration using OFF. Every algorithm including JANUS must run true single-view path or hold lane. Equal search range and resource class.

B.name: paired_view
B.information: Same ON1/OFF1/ON2/OFF2 native scans and actual timing, grids and role metadata for every method. Compare native supported cadence pipeline or documented independent adapter, with a common prespecified matching/veto baseline applied identically to candidates. Separate canonical pipeline from common wrapper. Keep transient/intermittent and shared injections as separate strata, not blanket veto.

preconditions: Independent custodian signs exact source target/day/sky/raw hash exclusions across all JANUS historical groups; verify actual per-scan pointing independent of target catalogue, UTC/MJD and role; independent qualification and blind heldout manifest. R41S1G1 yielded 0 qualified groups.

Development/tuning, calibration, blind test disjoint by group/observation, no hidden injection labels revealed before immutable predictions submitted. Include authentic null backgrounds, stationary/drift/nonlinear/intermittent/weak/shared injections and calibrated natural controls when available; no claims of confirmed extraterrestrial origin.

Predeclare sample-size/power at observation-group level with custodian before final lock; target budget 35/640 = 0.0546875, not 35/512, report actual FPR and confidence intervals. On historical R41 panel 318/69/<=35; on fresh panel report denominators and paired preservation rather than demand identical counts.

Pin exact native source, environment, config, preprocessing and evaluation; record file hashes and artifacts. No changes after blind start. Freeze before evaluation, independent checkout and replication.

tuning_parity.rule: Separate equal-information development set and equal declared runtime/trial budgets per method; search parameter grids recommended by respective maintainers, no audit or blind tuning. Log every trial, stop conditions and selected configuration with checksum; method-specific defaults plus tuned versions reported separately. Freeze CPU/GPU lanes separately; measure entire data-access + compute pipeline.

janus: paired variant with same tuning budget

metrics.primary: Localized positive recall under <=5.46875% null calibration budget, localization ±2 native channels on >=75% active rows (when defined); preserve paired hits including weak/shared; separate natural positive control detection from injection trajectory localization. Report realized test FPR; target <=5.46875% not guaranteed by calibration.
metrics.curves: Score ROC and localization-aware DET (FNR vs FPR), resolution near 1%, all method curves and locked operating markers, thresholds calibrated only on separate calibration; no retrospective retune. Nonlocalizing positives count as missed. Define one scalar score per complete pipeline before test, handle fail-open/unknown explicitly; no curve fabricated from binary alerts.
metrics.statistics: Group-wise paired bootstrap or permutation intervals predeclared by custodian, no independent-row assumption, multiplicity and uncertainty. Report added/lost/weak/shared and ordinary, per group, resource costs and input-access equality.
